# Token Gourmand for GitHub Copilot

Before starting engineering work, read and follow:

- [Token Gourmand Core](../.ai/CORE.md)
- [Project Context](../.ai/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md)

When no role or execution path has already been selected, start with **Engineering Router**. When a custom agent is active, follow its linked shared role contract. Preserve the native Copilot custom-agent tools and handoffs defined under `.github/agents/`.

Use Copilot handoffs when the current client supports them. If a selected reasoning model is outside the handoff system, pass it only the compact standalone packet defined by the shared workflow.
